text:
Maya (People Ops): FYI — 3pm guest arriving for a quick demo. They'll bring a framed print (fragile) + a courier with 2 boxes. Need a temp badge and a quiet seat. Badge printer showed a 'low ribbon' warning this morning. Can someone cover front desk at ~2:50 so I can meet them in the lobby?

Kai (Front Desk): I’m on desk 2:30–5. I can grab the courier. Where do you want fragile stored?

Liam (Design): We have the overflow shelf behind the mailroom, but framed stuff gets dented. If possible put it in Locker B2 upright. Tag it 'FRAGILE — DO NOT STACK'.

Nina (People Ops): I’ll bring bubble wrap + foam corners and the dolly. Also bringing visitor lanyards (blue). If the printer jams, we use the QR temp badge: https://cal.me/badge-temp

Maya (People Ops): Awesome. If the ribbon dies I’ll do the QR. Kai — can you paper-label Locker B2 with a Sharpie and set a calendar reminder for pickup tomorrow 10am? Thx :pray:

Kai (Front Desk): Yup. Label done. Reminder set.

VisitorBot: Guest "H. Ortega" checked in via RSVP at 14:42. Expected: 15:00. Host: Maya.

Liam (Design): Courier ETA?

Kai (Front Desk): ETA 14:55 per pickup call. One large box says "ARTWORK — FRAGILE"; other is "PROP STAND".

Maya (People Ops): Perfect. Also quick heads-up: please avoid using the red "visitor" ribbons today — we have a client on-site and they'd like muted lanyards :slightly_smiling_face:

Nina (People Ops): Got it. Blue lanyards only. Also anyone bringing food for the guest? I can grab a small gluten-free snack pack if needed.

Liam (Design): I got mini granola + coffee on me.

Maya (People Ops): Thanks team. Will post final check-in if anything changes. :thumbsup:
